verdict.rationale: Obsidian's plain-text vault and public Vault API (interact with files/folders) plus its community-plugin ecosystem (Bases, Dataview-like queries, Templater) provide the building blocks for scripted or plugin-driven bulk actions across many notes, but there is no first-party 'bulk operations' feature or documented AI-native batch-processing workflow. missing for 10: a native bulk edit/rename/delete UI or command, explicit AI-agent bulk-automation documentation, and hands-on evidence of large-scale batch operations succeeding in practice.
